name: cost-guard
description: Holds a message that would cost more than your token or dollar limit (cold prompt cache or a very large message), explains why, and asks before sending. Can also keep the cache warm during a break.

maxContextPercent.title: Token limit (% of context window)
maxContextPercent.description: Hold a message when the input tokens it pays full price for (a cold cache re-write plus the message itself) reach this percentage of the model's context window. 0 turns this check off.

maxTokens.title: Token limit (absolute)
maxTokens.description: Same check as a fixed token count. When above 0 it replaces the percentage limit.

maxUsd.title: Dollar limit
maxUsd.description: Hold a message when its estimated input cost, at API list price, reaches this many US dollars. 0 turns the dollar check off.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a reply. auto uses CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL or the promptCacheTtl setting when set; otherwise the lifetime measured from your own responses, and until one is measured 1h with a Claude account or 5m with an API key or cloud provider.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Input price override
inputUsdPerMTok.description: Base input price in US dollars per million tokens. 0 picks the list price of the session's model.

showCost.title: Show each message's cost
showCost.description: on (the default) adds two lines under each reply: what the message cost, its input and Claude's reply; then the session's and today's totals. off shows nothing.
